paragraphs.text: Learner drivers who take lessons once a week usually need about 45 hours of lessons before passing. Those who take two lessons a week often need fewer hours in total, because they forget less between lessons.
Practising with a family member between lessons can help, but instructors warn that parents may pass on bad habits, such as holding the steering wheel with one hand.
The theory test includes a section on recognising hazards, which is shown as video clips. Many learners fail this part because they react too late or click too often.
On the day of the practical test, candidates are allowed to take their instructor with them in the car. This can calm nerves, although the instructor may not speak during the test.
Nearly half of all candidates fail their first practical test, although many pass at the second attempt. The most common reasons are not checking mirrors and not looking carefully at junctions.

Shared offices, where freelancers and small companies rent desks by the day or month, have become popular in many cities. The cheapest option is usually a hot desk, which means users sit wherever there is a free space.
Members who pay more can have a fixed desk, where they can leave their computer and papers overnight. Private rooms for teams are also available but cost several times more.
Most shared offices include internet, printing and coffee in the price. Meeting rooms can usually be booked free of charge for a limited number of hours each month.
Many members say the main benefit is not the desk but the people. Regular social events help freelancers meet potential clients and avoid feeling isolated.
However, open shared spaces can be noisy, and some members find it hard to concentrate. Most offices provide phone booths for private calls. Some also have a separate quiet room.

items.quote: Those who take two lessons a week often need fewer hours in total
items.prompt: Learners who have two lessons a week

explanation.en: “Those who take two lessons a week often need fewer hours in total” → D. C is wrong: 45 hours is typical, not a required minimum.
explanation.kk: «Those who take two lessons a week often need fewer hours in total» → D. C қате: 45 сағат — міндетті ең аз мөлшер емес, әдеттегі сан.
explanation.ru: «Those who take two lessons a week often need fewer hours in total» → D. C неверен: 45 часов — обычная цифра, а не обязательный минимум.

items.quote: parents may pass on bad habits
items.prompt: Parents who help learners to practise

explanation.en: Instructors warn that “parents may pass on bad habits” → F. G exaggerates: practising with parents “can help”.
explanation.kk: Нұсқаушылар «parents may pass on bad habits» деп ескертеді → F. G асыра айтады: ата-анамен жаттығу «can help».
explanation.ru: Инструкторы предупреждают, что «parents may pass on bad habits» → F. G преувеличивает: практика с родителями «can help».

items.quote: a section on recognising hazards, which is shown as video clips
items.prompt: The hazard section of the theory test

explanation.en: The hazard section “is shown as video clips” → A.
explanation.kk: Қауіп бөлімі «is shown as video clips» → A.
explanation.ru: Раздел об опасностях «is shown as video clips» → A.

items.quote: This can calm nerves, although the instructor may not speak during the test
items.prompt: An instructor on the day of the practical test

explanation.en: The instructor can be in the car but “may not speak during the test” → E.
explanation.kk: Нұсқаушы көлікте бола алады, бірақ «may not speak during the test» → E.
explanation.ru: Инструктор может быть в машине, но «may not speak during the test» → E.

items.quote: The most common reasons are not checking mirrors and not looking carefully at junctions
items.prompt: Many candidates who fail the practical test

explanation.en: A common reason for failing is “not looking carefully at junctions” → B.
explanation.kk: Жиі кездесетін себеп — «not looking carefully at junctions» → B.
explanation.ru: Частая причина провала — «not looking carefully at junctions» → B.

items.quote: The cheapest option is usually a hot desk

explanation.en: The text says “The cheapest option is usually a hot desk”. Fixed desks and private rooms cost more → C.
explanation.kk: «Hot desk» туралы: «The cheapest option is usually a hot desk». Тұрақты үстел мен жеке бөлме қымбатырақ → C.
explanation.ru: О «hot desk» сказано: «The cheapest option is usually a hot desk». Фиксированный стол и отдельные комнаты стоят дороже → C.

items.quote: where they can leave their computer and papers overnight
keywords: leave their computer and papers overnight

explanation.en: At a fixed desk members can “leave their computer and papers overnight” → A.
explanation.kk: Тұрақты үстелде «leave their computer and papers overnight» болады → A.
explanation.ru: За фиксированным столом можно «leave their computer and papers overnight» → A.

items.quote: Meeting rooms can usually be booked free of charge for a limited number of hours each month

explanation.en: “Meeting rooms can usually be booked free of charge for a limited number of hours” → E. D contradicts “free of charge”.
explanation.kk: «Meeting rooms can usually be booked free of charge for a limited number of hours» → E. D «free of charge» дегенге қайшы.
explanation.ru: «Meeting rooms can usually be booked free of charge for a limited number of hours» → E. D противоречит «free of charge».

items.quote: Regular social events help freelancers meet potential clients

explanation.en: Social events help with work: “Regular social events help freelancers meet potential clients”. “Find new clients” = “meet potential clients” → F.
explanation.kk: Мүшелердің кездесуі жұмысқа пайдалы: «Regular social events help freelancers meet potential clients». «Find new clients» = «meet potential clients» → F.
explanation.ru: Встречи участников полезны для работы: «Regular social events help freelancers meet potential clients». «Find new clients» = «meet potential clients» → F.

items.quote: Most offices provide phone booths for private calls

explanation.en: “Most offices provide phone booths for private calls” → B. G contradicts the text: shared offices can be noisy.
explanation.kk: «Most offices provide phone booths for private calls» → B. G мәтінге қайшы: ортақ кеңседе шулы болады.
explanation.ru: «Most offices provide phone booths for private calls» → B. G противоречит тексту: в общих офисах бывает шумно.
